scope: Six small portions of cooked lingonberry dessert sauce, using 250g edible unsweetened lingonberries, 70ml tap water, 55g sugar and 10g undiluted lemon juice. Unstrained with all berries and fibre retained. Water evaporation does not remove carbohydrate, protein or fat. Edible weight estimates, no physical laboratory assay.

ingredients.matchEvidence: Fineli #440 generic unsweetened Finnish lingonberry, raw/frozen; berry solids remain in finished sauce. No fruit variety substitute.
ingredients.edibleEvidence: Measured edible part of ingredient, no peel or berry solids discarded.
ingredients.retentionEvidence: Unstrained cooked berry sauce; all macro-bearing solids and dissolved sugar retained. Evaporated water is not counted as nutrient loss.
